resources.string: Nightmare Alarm: block the power menu

This is on only while a Nightmare Alarm rings: you turn it on with its shortcut when the alarm wakes you (hold both volume keys for 3 s), and it turns itself off when the alarm ends, so it is never on during the day. While it is on, it looks only at system windows, to recognize the power off / restart menu and close it, so the alarm cannot be escaped by turning the phone off. It stores nothing.
